image_description: A male black grouse (blackcock) standing on dry, grassy ground. The bird displays characteristic glossy black plumage with iridescent blue/purple sheen on the neck and breast, prominent red eyebrow combs (caruncles), and white undertail coverts visible near the tail base. The body is robust and stocky with a low, ground-dwelling posture.
